subject: Phased invoicing + 10% VAT retention — AptEdge PO and credit limit
messages:
From: Julien Moreau <julien@aptedge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: AptEdge Finance <finance@aptedge.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Request: Net60 for pilot + PO

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency/throughput profile. Our finance team is pushing for Net60 payment terms for the coming pilot due to cashflow alignment across our subsidiaries.

Can Redwood accept Net60 for the 6-week pilot if we provide a PO this week? We can also provide a supplier reference and a purchase order immediately. Additionally, we need confirmation of the VAT treatment — our tax team needs evidence you will provide EU VAT invoices or a reverse-charge setup.

I attached our PO template.

Best,
Julien Moreau
Head of Platform Ops, AptEdge
[Attachment: AptEdge_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf, 34KB)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Julien Moreau <julien@aptedge.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + PO

Hi Julien — great to hear the demo resonated.

We can be flexible, but to protect both sides and move quickly I propose a phased invoicing schedule instead of an unconditional Net60: 

- Invoice 1: 50% of pilot value, due Net30 upon PO receipt (to cover initial provisioning and reserved capacity).
- Invoice 2: 40% after successful mid-point validation, due Net45.
- Retention: final 10% held and invoiced Net60 once we receive the VAT evidence / reverse-charge confirmation from AptEdge (or proof of exemption).

This structure lets you keep effective payment cadence while giving Redwood a short-term cash cushion. We can also approve a credit limit once we complete a quick credit check — do you have a supplier reference and the requested PO?

If that works for you I will loop in finance and prepare a tailored order form + DocuSign.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
Tel: +44 20 7946 09XX

From: Julien Moreau <julien@aptedge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: AptEdge Finance <finance@aptedge.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T13:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + PO

Sofia — thanks for the quick proposal; that phased plan is reasonable. Two asks from our CFO:

1) Can you shift Invoice 1 to Net30 and Invoice 2 to Net60 (instead of Net45)? CFO wants longer clearance on the second tranche.
2) We also need Redwood to approve an initial credit line of EUR 250,000 to cover the pilot + expected expansion.

I've attached the PO template and flagged the billing contact. We can provide a bank reference but not a guarantee.

If you can confirm the VAT documentation process (how long it takes for Redwood to issue corrected VAT invoices or support reverse-charge) we can sign the PO and move forward.

Regards,
Julien
[Attachment: AptEdge_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf, 34KB)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:07:00+02:00
Subject: Fwd: AptEdge — Net60 / credit limit request (need finance review)

Team — forwarding AptEdge's counterproposal. Key asks: Invoice 2 Net60 (vs our proposed Net45) and initial credit line EUR 250k. They can provide PO and bank reference, no guarantee. VAT evidence still required; they want a process timeline.

Questions for finance / credit:
- Can we approve a EUR 250k credit line for a first-time customer with a bank reference?
- If we do, what guardrails (e.g., upfront % or milestone triggers) should we require? My suggested commercial guardrail: keep our Invoice 1 at 50% Net30 and require the second tranche to be Net45 with a 10% retention held until VAT confirmation; if Finance insists on granting Net60, require an immediate 25% prepayment or escrow until the credit profile is verified.

Marissa / Naomi — can you run a quick credit check and advise by EOD today? Karthik — flag if this needs escalated discount / approval.

Thanks,
Sofia

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AptEdge — Net60 / credit limit request (finance decision)

Hi all — ran the credit check and contacted their bank reference. High-level findings: AptEdge is investment-backed, decent receivables history, no major adverse flags. Bank reference confirmed active relationship but would not provide a guarantee.

Finance recommendation: approve a conditional credit line of EUR 200,000 for the pilot with the following conditions:  
- Invoice 1: 50% Net30 upon PO (no change)
- Invoice 2: 40% Net45 (compromise)
- Retention: 10% withheld and payable Net60 after VAT evidence is provided (we will accept EU reverse-charge documentation or a local VAT invoice).
- If AptEdge insists on Net60 for Invoice 1, require a 25% upfront prepayment (to mitigate upfront provisioning cost).

We can raise to EUR 250k only after a second purchase order and one on-time payment. This mitigates exposure while allowing the pilot to start.

Sofia — please confirm to the customer and attach our order form and the DocuSign link.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Julien Moreau <julien@aptedge.com>
Cc: AptEdge Finance <finance@aptedge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + PO — Redwood decision

Hi Julien — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. We have a path forward that should allow the pilot to start this week: 

1) Credit line — conditional approval for EUR 200,000. We will consider moving to EUR 250,000 after a second PO and one on-time payment.
2) Invoicing schedule (final):
   - Invoice 1: 50% due Net30 upon PO receipt (we prefer not to move this to Net60).
   - Invoice 2: 40% due Net45 after mid-point validation.
   - Retention: final 10% invoiced Net60 and released upon receipt of VAT evidence (reverse-charge or local VAT invoice).
3) If AptEdge requires Invoice 1 to be Net60, Redwood will accept that only with a 25% upfront prepayment instead of 50% (i.e., 25% prepay + 25% Net60 on Invoice 1) — this is to cover provisioning costs.

Please sign the attached order form and return the PO. I've included the DocuSign link for the order form and attached our Order Form PDF. Once we have the PO and signed order form we'll provision the pilot cluster.

Attachments: Redwood_Order_Form_v1.pdf; VAT_edocumentation.zip (for reference: list of accepted VAT docs and sample invoices)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/embedded?token=0a1b2c3d

Let me know if you want to jump on a 15-minute call to finalize.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_Order_Form_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB); VAT_edocumentation.zip (application/zip, 12KB)]
